content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"It resolves the challenge by setting the challenger's footed covenant-origin chain against Matthew 1:20's own wording, which is the chain-versus-verse-by-verse situation K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb; answered in [CR3] LINK 2.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"never verse by verse: one reading is that no single verse's own wording may resolve a pressing-side chain collision, while the other is that Matthew 1:20's own wording may answer the challenger's analogy.","why":"By letting the sentence's own words answer the footed challenger chain, the judge applies the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing the two chains by footing."}
